lines.en: label wakanaspring3:
scene sky
I’m wide awake, it’s morning — and while the clouds are here to greet me, joined by the light and the wind, I fight them away and embrace my role as everyone’s favorite half-tangible parasite.
lines.zh: 我醒得很透，天已亮了——云、光和风一道来迎接我，我把它们挥开，接受了自己作为「大家最爱的半透明寄生虫」这个角色。

lines.en: Today, I will find a host. I will burrow into their flesh and take up residence in some hard-to-reach place, living off of their blood instead of my own because mine scares me sometimes.
lines.zh: 今天，我要找一个宿主。我要钻进他们的肉里，在某个够不着的角落住下来，靠他们的血过活而不是我自己的——因为我自己的血有时候会吓到我。

lines.en: Sometimes, I feel like there’s more to it than its color. Its viscosity. How I can’t live without it and yet, how knowing it’s there makes my skin try to crawl away.
lines.zh: 有时候我觉得，它里面有比颜色、比黏稠度更多的东西。我离了它就活不下去，可光是知道它在那儿，我的皮肤就想爬着逃走。

lines.en: But such a feat is impossible as only ghosts can escape themselves. So while I long for the day where I can roam the halls of the dead, for now I have the clouds.
lines.zh: 但这种本事我做不到，因为只有鬼才能逃离自己。所以虽然我渴望有一天能漫步在亡者的厅堂里，眼下我还有云。

lines.en: The light.
lines.zh: 还有光。

lines.en: The wind.
lines.zh: 还有风。

lines.en: And a phone call from a good friend.
lines.zh: 还有一位好朋友打来的电话。

lines.en: scene bedroom_day
: Hello?
: Wakana? Are you there?
lines.zh: : Wakana？你在吗？

lines.en: : Arakawa...
lines.zh: : 荒川……

lines.en: : You’re not busy today, are you?
lines.zh: : 你今天不忙吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I’m rarely busy at all these days. Aren’t you normally in school around this time, though?
lines.zh: : 我想说……我最近基本上没什么忙的。不过这个点你不是该在学校吗？

lines.en: : It’s Saturday. But I suppose you wouldn’t know that if the days of your prolonged absence have begun to congeal into some indiscernible blob.
lines.zh: : 今天是周六。不过你旷了那么久的工，日子想必已经糊成了一团辨不出形状的玩意儿。

lines.en: : I know it’s Saturday. But you’re normally still over there, like...watering your plants or grading papers. Stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道是周六。可你平时这会儿还在那儿，比如……给植物浇水、批作业之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t have anything to grade right now...and I watered my plants before I left the building yesterday. I can leave them alone until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我现在没东西要批……而且昨天离开教学楼前就已经浇过水了。放它们到明天也没事。

lines.en: : Okay. So...why are you calling, then? You don’t normally do that unless you need my help with something.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那……你为什么打电话？你一般不打，除非有事要我帮忙。

lines.en: : Can you come over?
lines.zh: : 你能过来一趟吗？

lines.en: : To your place?
lines.zh: : 去你家？

lines.en: : That is correct.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : You don’t need my help cooking again, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会又要我帮忙做饭吧？

lines.en: : It’s not like that, I-
lines.zh: : 不是那回事，我——

lines.en: : I could just really use the company.
lines.zh: : 我只是真的需要有人陪。

lines.en: : But if you already have plans, it’s-
lines.zh: : 不过你要有安排的话，那就——

lines.en: : No, I’ll head over now. Does that work?
lines.zh: : 不，我现在就过去。行吗？

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to be now. Any time you-
lines.zh: : 不必现在。你随时——

lines.en: scene black
: Nope. Getting dressed and coming over now. You can deal with me when I get there.
lines.zh: : 不必。我穿衣服，现在过去。你等我到了再对付我吧。

lines.en: : Arakawa-
lines.zh: : 荒川——

lines.en: I hang up the phone and throw on the same outfit as always, but I grab an umbrella out of the closet as well since I’d be crazy to not expect rain when the clouds have already turned grey.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，套上那身万年不变的行头，顺便从柜子里抓了把伞——云都灰了，不防着点雨就太傻了。

lines.en: Surely, that was Wakana’s doing. And surely I shouldn’t question why when I’ve already learned the reason for the cracks in her sky.
lines.zh: 想必那是 Wakana 的功劳。而我也不该追问为什么——既然我已经知道了她天空上的那些裂缝是怎么来的。

lines.en: But if I’m to keep her out of the rain, which is surely why she needs me now, it’s best that I stay dry.
lines.zh: 但如果我要替她挡雨（她现在需要我，想必就是为了这个），那我自己最好别湿。

lines.en: I can’t imagine she’d take kindly to me tracking mud all over her floors.
lines.zh: 我想她不会乐意我把泥踩得她一地板都是。

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt1
: Thanks for coming. I can make tea to repay you, if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你过来。我可以泡茶答谢你，如果你想要的话。

lines.en: : I’m good. But I do take exception to the implication that you’d only offer me a drink if you owe me something.
lines.zh: : 不用了。不过你「只有欠我东西才肯给我倒点喝的」这个暗示，我可不大乐意。

lines.en: : I only keep the expensive stuff in here. The kind that would be lost on someone like you. So forgive me for keeping it to myself on most occasions.
lines.zh: : 我这里只放贵的东西。那种给你这种人喝纯属浪费。所以平时我藏着不拿出来，请原谅。

lines.en: : You are forgiven. Now, what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 原谅你了。那么，到底怎么了？

lines.en: : I need you to clean my shower.
lines.zh: : 我需要你把我的淋浴间打扫一下。

lines.en: : Ahh, okay.
lines.zh: : 啊，好。

lines.en: : And it would be great if you could wash the floors while you’re at it.
lines.zh: : 如果顺手把地板擦了就更好了。

lines.en: : Anything else?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗？

lines.en: : If you could get inside the oven, that would be greatly appreciated as well.
lines.zh: : 如果你能钻进烤箱里，那就更感激不尽了。

lines.en: : As in...cleaning it? Or literally getting inside of the oven so you can kill me?
lines.zh: : 你是说……清理它？还是字面意义上钻进烤箱，好让你把我烤了？

lines.en: : I suppose the former as burning you to a crisp would surely make the oven even harder to clean.
lines.zh: : 大概是前者，因为把你烤成焦炭，烤箱只会更难清理。

lines.en: : Your wish is my command, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 你的愿望就是我的命令，Wakana。

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt2
: You’re being awfully obedient today.
lines.zh: : 你今天异常听话啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you’re looking awfully pathetic.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是你看起来异常可怜。

lines.en: : You always look awfully pathetic.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候看着不可怜。

lines.en: : You’re right. Which is precisely why I know to go along with anything you say right now as it probably feels nice to have some power back, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你说得对。所以我才对你言听计从——因为你现在大概是觉得重新有点掌控感挺舒服的，对吧？

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt3
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不好。

lines.en: : And since you’ve managed to figure that out all on your own, I suppose you can forgo all of the cleaning and just...sit with me for a little while.
lines.zh: : 既然你自己就能想明白这一点，那么打扫就算了，你就……陪我坐一会儿吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Lead the way, princess.
lines.zh: : 带路吧，公主殿下。

lines.en: : Please don’t ever call me “princess” again — even in the midst of my most miserable days.
lines.zh: : 以后别再叫我「公主」了——哪怕是我最惨的日子里也别。

lines.en: : Are any of your days better than “miserable?” Because my understanding was that was just the baseline.
lines.zh: : 你的日子有哪天比「惨」好过吗？我一直以为「惨」就是你的基准线。

lines.en: : And it normally is...
lines.zh: : 通常是这样没错……

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt4
: But things have been exponentially worse lately and I...may be having a difficult time getting adjusted to that.
lines.zh: : 但最近状况呈指数级恶化，而我……可能不太适应得来。

lines.en: Wakana and I take a seat on the couch and she immediately pulls her knees up to her chest.
lines.zh: Wakana 和我在沙发上坐下，她立刻把膝盖抱到了胸前。

lines.en: And while this may make it a little harder for me to find a soft spot to burrow into and start living off of her blood, I have faith I’ll figure it out soon enough.
lines.zh: 虽然这样一来，我更难找到一处柔软的地方钻进去、开始靠她的血过活，但我有信心很快就找到办法。

lines.en: But who knows? Maybe if I can get a strong enough taste of whatever she’s feeling from a few inches away, I won’t have to do that at all.
lines.zh: 不过谁知道呢？也许隔着几英寸我就能尝够她现在的情绪，根本用不着那么干。

lines.en: : Osako, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 是 Osako 的事吧，我猜？

lines.en: : I heard the two of you went out the other night...
lines.zh: : 我听说你俩前几天晚上出去了……

lines.en: : Wait. You’re not...jealous, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等。你不会……在吃醋吧？

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt5
: What? Don’t be ridiculous. Osako wouldn’t fall for you even if you had the correct genitalia.
lines.zh: : 什么？别犯蠢。就算你长了正确的那套器官，Osako 也不会看上你。

lines.en: : Then why did you sound so forlorn when you mentioned the two of us meeting just now?
lines.zh: : 那你刚才提到我们俩见面的时候，语气为什么那么凄凉？

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt6
: I wasn’t trying to sound forlorn. I was just using that as a bridge to...acknowledge that you likely understand what the two of us are going through right now.
lines.zh: : 我不是故意要显得凄凉。我只是拿它当个引子，好……承认你大概能理解我们俩现在正在经历什么。

lines.en: : I’ve known since the beach trip that things haven’t been perfect. I just don’t fully understand why. But I guess that’s between you two and not me.
lines.zh: : 从海边那趟起我就知道你们之间不完美。我只是不完全明白为什么。不过我想那是你俩之间的事，不是我的。

lines.en: : Things have been...imperfect for several months now. But it wasn’t until after that trip that they...really started to change.
lines.zh: : 几个月以来……一直都不完美。但直到那趟旅行之后，它们才……真的开始变了。

lines.en: : And I guess I’m just...so used to the way they’ve always been that seeing her trying to better herself has set off something in my brain that’s making me think all of this is wrong.
lines.zh: : 而我大概……太习惯它们一贯的样子了，所以看着她试图让自己变得更好，反而触发了我脑子里的某根弦，让我觉得这一切都不对。

lines.en: : Well...she made it sound like she was the issue in the first place. Which is why she’s doing all of this to begin with, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯……她自己说一开始问题出在她身上。所以她才做这一切，对吧？

lines.en: : She’s not the only issue. I have my fair share of faults as well. I just worry that...I may have been a little too harsh on her.
lines.zh: : 她不是唯一的问题。我也有我那份毛病。我只是担心……我可能对她太苛刻了点。

lines.en: : So that’s what this is? Just...general worrying? No earth-shattering revelations or drama for me to help you with?
lines.zh: : 所以就是这么回事？只是……普通的担心？没有惊天大揭密、也没有要我帮忙处理的狗血剧情？

lines.en: : Does that come as a disappointment?
lines.zh: : 这么说让你失望了？

lines.en: : I’d say it’s a relief, if anything.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我反而松了口气。

lines.en: : Yes, well...I wouldn’t be too relieved if I were you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过……换作是我，我不会松那么快。

lines.en: : From the outside, I’m sure it’s easy to look at this as the two of us “trying to work through something,” but we’ve worked through plenty of things in the past and it’s never felt like this...
lines.zh: : 从外面看，别人八成很容易把它当成我们俩「在试着跨过某件事」，可我们过去跨过不少事了，从来没有这种感觉……

lines.en: : So...perhaps it’s just the eternal pessimist in me that’s perceiving it as some sort of omen. I hope that’s the case. Regardless, I needed someone to steel my heart for me, so...here you are.
lines.zh: : 所以……也许只是我骨子里那个永恒的悲观主义者，把它当成了某种征兆。我希望是这样的。不管怎样，我需要有人替我把心加加固，所以……你来了。

lines.en: : I get it. I’m just surprised you’d trust me with something like that over Imani.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我只是有点意外，这种事你居然信任我而不是 Imani。

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt7
: Imani has her strengths, and she’s better than you in more ways than I can count.
lines.zh: : Imani 有她的长处，她比你强的地方多得数不清。

lines.en: : But you’re the one I’m more comfortable with, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 但你是我待着更舒服的那个人，荒川。

lines.en: : Uhh...why?
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么？

lines.en: : I suppose you just feel like a brother to me. A cousin, perhaps? But I can rest my head on your shoulder like this and feel absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 大概是你就让我觉得像哥哥吧。或者表哥？但我可以这样把头靠在你肩上，心里毫无波澜。

lines.en: : You have a real gift for accidentally insulting people, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 你这无心伤人真是天赋异禀，Wakana。

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt8
: It was a joke, idiot. I don’t feel nothing. I feel...secure. And as great of a friend Imani is, it never really feels as if she’s watching over me, you know?
lines.zh: : 那是玩笑，白痴。我不是毫无感觉。我感觉……安心。而且 Imani 虽然是个很好的朋友，可从来没有那种「她在看着我」的感觉，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I’m sorry for being the way I am. You’re extremely special to me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我是这么个样子。你对我来说非常特别。

lines.en: : Maybe be a little less sorry if possible, though. Because if I have to deal with you and Osako going through monumental personality changes at once, I’m not sure how I’m going to process it.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是能少道歉点就更好了。因为如果你和 Osako 同时进行里程碑式的性格大改造，我真不确定该怎么消化。

lines.en: : I’ll go back to normal shortly. I just wanted to be vulnerable for a little while. And while all logic says I should do that as far away from you as possible, I decided to challenge it.
lines.zh: : 我很快就恢复正常。我只是想脆弱一会儿。虽然按道理我应该离你远远的再做这件事，但我决定反着来。

lines.en: : Okay. But if your girlfriend comes through that door and sees you cozying up to me, you have to explain everything in five seconds or I am very likely going to die.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过要是你女朋友进门看见你跟我这么亲热，你得在五秒内向她解释清楚，否则我很可能死在这儿。

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt9
: I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 我尽量吧。

lines.en: : That doesn’t bode well for my future. But I’ll take it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 这话对我前途可不太妙。不过我认了。

lines.en: scene black
: Arakawa...can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : 荒川……我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: : Nope. I just came over here to eat your food and watch your TV.
lines.zh: : 不行。我来就是为了吃你的饭、看你的电视。

lines.en: : I guess I can humor you if you keep it brief, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是简短点，我倒可以迁就你一下。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : I just wanted to know if you’d think any less of me if I forced you to hold me so I can cry into your chest for a little while.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，如果我逼你抱着我，让我趴在你胸口哭一会儿，你会不会看不起我。

lines.en: : Do I even have the right to refuse? Because you’re already changing positions and-
lines.zh: : 我还有拒绝的权利吗？因为你已经开始换姿势了，而且——

lines.en: : Nope. Here I come. Move your legs.
lines.zh: : 没有。我来了。把腿挪开。

lines.en: : Where? There’s nowhere to go.
lines.zh: : 挪哪儿？没地方挪啊。

lines.en: : Well, figure it out because I’m only a few seconds away from a full-on breakdown and I’d like you to close your eyes for it so you can preserve your image of me.
lines.zh: : 那就自己想办法，因为我还有几秒就要彻底崩了；而且我希望你闭上眼睛，好保住你心里那个我的形象。

lines.en: : But the image I have of you sucks.
lines.zh: : 可我心里的那个形象糟透了。

lines.en: : Then maybe you’ll just have to hate me after today...
lines.zh: : 那也许从今天起你就只好恨我了……

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt10
Wakana quite literally crawls into my lap and finds a place to nestle herself between my legs.
lines.zh: Wakana 简直是真的爬到我腿上，在我两腿之间找了个地方把自己塞了进去。

lines.en: When she presses her head against my shoulder, I don’t hesitate to hold her close and stroke her hair.
lines.zh: 她把头抵在我肩上，我毫不犹豫地抱紧了她，抚摸她的头发。

lines.en: And yes, it...feels a little odd doing this for someone who, for the most part, has always seemed rather stoic. But there have been breaks in that that I’ve experienced over the years.
lines.zh: 说真的，对一个大体上一向显得很克制的人来说，做这种事感觉有点怪。但这些年我见过她破功的时候。

lines.en: And I know what it’s like to bottle things up for so long that the pressure just becomes too much. So I won’t think any less of her for being a little more human than normal now.
lines.zh: 我知道把东西憋太久、憋到压力撑不住是什么滋味。所以我不会因为她现在比平时更像个普通人而看轻她。

lines.en: I’m just thankful and...surprised that she’s willing to break in front of me.
lines.zh: 我只是很感激、也很意外——她愿意在我面前崩溃。

lines.en: For while I might not be good at collecting and reassembling the pieces, I love the way they look when the light hits them just right.
lines.zh: 因为虽然我不擅长把碎片捡起来重新拼好，但我爱极了光线正好的时候那些碎片的样子。

lines.en: For each tear that dribbles down her cheek, I make a wish on her behalf.
lines.zh: 她脸颊上每流下一滴泪，我就替她许一个愿。

lines.en: I wish for her happiness. I wish that her love survives. I wish that one day, if we can ever make it out of this place, that we can hold each other again somewhere closer to our deaths.
lines.zh: 我愿她幸福。我愿她的爱能活下来。我愿有一天，如果我们能离开这个地方，我们能在某个离死亡更近的地方再次拥抱彼此。

lines.en: But most of all, I just wish for her to stop crying so I can stop coming up with wishes that might never come true.
lines.zh: 但最要紧的是，我只愿她别再哭了，这样我就不用再许那些也许永远不会实现的愿了。

lines.en: : You’re not holding me tight enough...
lines.zh: : 你抱得不够紧……

lines.en: : Yeah well, look at how you’re sitting. What do you want me to do?
lines.zh: : 嗯，可你看看你这坐姿。你要我怎么办？

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt11
: Hold me tighter, idiot! Squeeze the life out of me! I need it!
lines.zh: : 抱紧点，白痴！把我的命都挤出来！我需要！

lines.en: : You need to be squeezed to death?
lines.zh: : 你需要被挤到死？

lines.en: : Yes! Haven’t you ever been sad before?!
lines.zh: : 对！你没难过过吗？！

lines.en: : Of course. But normally when I wish for death, I do it in a less cute way.
lines.zh: : 当然有。不过通常我想死的时候，不会用这么可爱的方式。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I’m a cute girl and you’re a stupid, terrible, horrible man! Hug me harder!
lines.zh: : 哼，我可是个可爱的女孩，而你这个愚蠢、糟糕、讨人厌的男人！抱得更用力！

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt12
: You get really needy when you cry, huh?
lines.zh: : 你哭起来还真黏人啊。

lines.en: : I’m really needy all the time. I just never ask for anything because everyone other than me is incompetent.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很黏人。我只是从不提要求，因为除我之外所有人都不中用。

lines.en: : Does that mean I have the green light to just hug you whenever I want then?
lines.zh: : 那是不是说，我以后就能随时随地想抱就抱了？

lines.en: : Maybe...Not if anyone else is around, though. I don’t want anybody to know I actually really like you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧……不过有别人在的时候不行。我可不想让任何人知道我其实很喜欢你。

lines.en: : Yeah, why do you like me anyway?
lines.zh: : 话说你到底为什么喜欢我？

lines.en: : Shut up, Arakawa. This is my time to be sad. We’re talking about me right now. So shower me in compliments until I stop crying. That’s an order.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，荒川。现在是我难过的时间。现在谈的是我。所以给我堆一堆好听的话，直到我停止哭泣。这是命令。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: You’re...really smart.
lines.zh: : 你……真的很聪明。

lines.en: : More.
lines.zh: : 还有呢。

lines.en: : You’ve...got a really nice figure?
lines.zh: : 你……身材很好？

lines.en: : More. But less creepy.
lines.zh: : 还有。但少点变态。

lines.en: scene black
: You...smell nice?
lines.zh: : 你……闻起来很香？

lines.en: : I just told you to be less creepy! How can you be this bad at simply hugging someone?!
lines.zh: : 我刚说少点变态！你怎么能连「单纯抱个人」都做得这么烂？！

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt13
Things carry on that way for another thirty minutes or so before Wakana swiftly tears herself away from me and-
lines.zh: 就这么又过了三十来分钟，然后 Wakana 猛地从我身上挣开，并且——

lines.en: : That never happened.
lines.zh: : 那件事从没发生过。

lines.en: And goes back to being Wakana.
lines.zh: 然后变回了 Wakana。

lines.en: : Feel any better now?
lines.zh: : 现在感觉好点了吗？

lines.en: Instead of pressing her about it and capitalizing on my free hug pass, though, I skip right to the point. Because, the quicker she feels normal, the quicker things become normal.
lines.zh: 不过我没有追问她，也没有趁机兑现我的「免费拥抱券」，而是直奔主题。因为她越快觉得自己正常，一切就越快回到正轨。

lines.en: And if I’m going to be following Osako on her path to self-acceptance, I don’t want any commentary to lead me down some road less traveled.
lines.zh: 而且既然我要陪着 Osako 走她的自我接纳之路，我可不想被什么闲话带到别的岔路上去。

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许？

lines.en: : How have you made it this far into adulthood without knowing how to properly hug someone?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么活到这么大、还不知道该怎么好好抱人的？

lines.en: : Probably because my brand of physical affection is best received by people who aren’t already in committed relationships.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我这套肢体示好的方式，最适合的对象是那些还没有稳定伴侣的人。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
Except for Haruka. But I’m pretty sure she wouldn’t have it any other way at this point.
lines.zh: Haruka 除外。不过我敢肯定，到了这一步，她也不会想要别的样子。

lines.en: : Save it for Imani, you devious disgrace of a man.
lines.zh: : 留着给 Imani 吧，你这阴险又丢人的男人。

lines.en: : Sure. Will you be there to hold her hand again, though? Because that made it really fun last time, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 好啊。不过你到时候还会再握着她的手吗？因为上次那样真的很有意思，不是吗？

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt14
: I can’t believe I allowed you to see my naked body — even in the throes of a foursome.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己居然让你看到了我的裸体——哪怕是在四人行的混乱之中。

lines.en: : I can’t believe Osako allowed me to see your naked body. That’s the real surprise here.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信 Osako 让我看了你的裸体。这里真正的意外是这个。

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt15
: Yeah, that was...odd. But I suppose it...might have been her first step?
lines.zh: : 是啊，那件事……挺奇怪的。不过我想……也许那是她的第一步？

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, that is one hell of a “first step.” Usually it’s haircut first, foursome second.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这「第一步」可真够猛的。通常人家是先理发，再搞四人行。

lines.en: : Yeah...but that’s another reason why I’m...
lines.zh: : 是啊……但这也是我为什么会……

lines.en: scene wakanasadapt16
: No, fuck it. No more of this depressing stuff. There’s enough of that to go around already. What we need is food and alcohol.
lines.zh: : 不，去它的。别再说这些丧气事了。丧气事已经够多了。我们需要的是食物和酒。

lines.en: : Have we already reached that point of the recovery process?
lines.zh: : 我们已经到「康复流程」的这一步了？

lines.en: : I demand sustenance, Arakawa. If I am going to spend my day off with the likes of you, I am going to need all the energy I can get.
lines.zh: : 我需要补给，荒川。既然我要跟你这种人凑一块儿过休息日，我就得把能补的能量都补上。

lines.en: : Fine by me. I skipped breakfast to come here. Is there anywhere you have in mind, though?
lines.zh: : 我没意见。我为了过来连早饭都没吃。不过你有想去的地方吗？

lines.en: : You choose. I’m too hungry to think.
lines.zh: : 你选。我饿得没法思考了。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay...I’ve got somewhere in mind.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我有个去处。

lines.en: : It’s a bit of a trip, though.
lines.zh: : 不过有点远。

lines.en: $ wakanaspring3 = True
$ wakana_love += 1
Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!
lines.zh: Wakana 的好感度提升到了 [wakana_love]！

lines.en: jump wakanaspring4
